## Test harness (D2R)

This repository is covered by the shared harness in `C:\Users\matt7\source\repos\d2r-test-harness`. Before you claim
a coded or data change works, test it there:

- `python -m harness conformance --target sim` — the harness itself is healthy
- `python -m harness live --slot 2` — every live verb, read back, in a real game
- `python -m harness run <scenario>.json` — a scenario is JSON with
  `setup`/`steps`/`assert`/`teardown`; see `C:\Users\matt7\source\repos\d2r-test-harness/SCENARIOS.md`
- `python -m harness test <plugin>.plugin.json` — verify a mod's hooks and data edits
- console lines go through `harness.console`; test slots launch with `-debug_mode`,
  so do not send the literal `debug mode` line (it toggles the mode off)
- `python -m harness enter-game --slot 2` — splash, retried Play and a drawn world in one command
- `python -m harness frontend --slot 2` — names the screen (`title`, `menu`, `character_list`, `in_game`)
- `ui.action` drives the frontend: `ui.action("MainMenuHD", "Play")` is proven
- `ui.skipSplash` (0x0709) passes the title screen; `GameCtlDriver.start_to_menu()` returns at the menu
- do **not** write a driver script in this repository: `enter-game`, `frontend`,
  `panel`, `keys` and `cursor` are the entrance, the screen and the input; ask for
  anything missing instead of growing a helper here
- `python -m harness feedback new --kind bug|feature --title ... --repo D2RVoidDropFix` —
  report a harness bug or a missing capability; reports land in
  `C:\Users\matt7\source\repos\d2r-test-harness/feedback/inbox/` (see `C:\Users\matt7\source\repos\d2r-test-harness/feedback/README.md`)

The harness is `C:\Users\matt7\source\repos\d2r-test-harness`. `D2RLSpeedRunBuddy` is a speedrun overlay, not a
harness: never build a test on its block, its word file or its log. Never run a
live scenario on slot 1.

Images: `D2RLoader.exe` is the game image (it contains `d2r.exe`; query its
unpacked dump). `d2r_loader.dll` is not a target; `D2RCore.dll` is the
important engine module.
